channel.title: Crypto Docket
channel.description: Crypto Docket reports news across crypto: Bitcoin and Ethereum, layer-2 networks, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and security incidents.

item.title: Chainalysis restores services after all-user credential exposure
item.description: Chainalysis says names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users were exposed; its core tools are back online after a week of shutdowns.

item.title: Zcash NU7 cuts target block time to 25 seconds
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting target block times to 25 seconds while changing fee flows and ending spends from its oldest pool.

item.title: Bitcoin reclaims $80,000 after Binance hack and midterms
item.description: Bitcoin rose 3.5% to $80,500 on Wednesday after a post-hack slide, while traders weighed the Binance recovery, election outcome and broader market risks.

item.title: Monad bridge: Fund now, move later?
item.description: A bridge moves assets between chains in a transaction; holding funds on Monad first is a separate choice, with different costs, timing and risks to weigh.

item.title: Flashbots Protect changes the route, not the swap
item.description: A private Ethereum transaction route can reduce public mempool exposure on a swap, but it cannot guarantee price, inclusion or protection from every form of MEV.

item.title: South Korea Seeks Fourth Delay to Crypto Tax, Now Until 2029
item.description: Seoul will seek to move crypto taxation from 2027 to 2029, citing missing US transaction data and rule changes, while proposing three-year loss offsets.

item.title: Binance says fake job interview preceded $6.34 billion theft
item.description: Binance says a fake job interview helped attackers steal $6.34 billion over months, showing how compromised staff and internal tools exposed wallet systems.

item.title: Binance traces record $6.34B theft to staged employee compromise
item.description: Binance says a staged employee compromise enabled the $6.34 billion theft, now the largest reported crypto heist, while recovery and independent review remain incomplete.

item.title: Mercado Bitcoin promises to absorb losses from $38M hack
item.description: Mercado Bitcoin says it will absorb about $38 million in losses after a hack across 10 blockchains, while partners froze $11 million of the stolen assets.

item.title: DTCC opens tokenization service for stocks, ETFs and Treasuries
item.description: DTCC has opened a service for tokenized stocks, ETFs and Treasuries, bringing securities held in its custody onto blockchains while limiting access to approved firms and assets.

item.title: Binance publishes verifiable reserves after $6.3bn breach
item.description: Binance says it has replenished 95% of the assets lost in its $6.3bn breach and published verifiable backing for ten tokens, while recovery continues.

item.title: Binance Reopens Withdrawals After $6.3bn Theft
item.description: Binance has begun restoring withdrawals in phases after a $6.3bn hot-wallet theft, with most affected assets replenished and the attack still under investigation.

item.title: Binance reopens withdrawals after $6.3bn hack
item.description: Binance has begun restoring withdrawals after a record $6.3 billion hack, while the FBI attributes the theft to North Korea and tracing efforts continue.

item.title: FBI attributes $6bn Binance theft to North Korean hackers
item.description: The FBI linked Binance’s October 29 theft of more than $6 billion to North Korea’s TraderTraitor, as funds move into Ethereum and laundering routes.

item.title: Binance confirms $6.3B hot-wallet loss, pledges full cover
item.description: Binance says hot wallets lost about $6.3 billion in tokens, promises to cover the loss and keeps withdrawals paused during security checks and recovery.

item.title: ICE plans U.S. Hyperliquid perpetuals market with Trade[XYZ]
item.description: ICE and Trade[XYZ] plan a separate U.S. venue for Hyperliquid-based perpetuals, adding 24/7 retail exposure across assets if regulators approve the market.

item.title: Binance freezes $2.54 billion as security probe halts transfers
item.description: Binance is investigating a potential security issue after crypto firms froze $2.54 billion, while deposits and withdrawals were paused and no theft was confirmed.

item.title: DTCC takes tokenized U.S. securities live on two blockchains
item.description: DTCC has launched tokenized versions of eligible securities on Canton and private Besu, linking blockchain transfers to DTC custody and existing investor protections.

item.title: Solana’s Alpenglow is live, but 150ms remains a target
item.description: Solana activated Alpenglow on Oct. 21, replacing TowerBFT; Anza targets 150ms finality, while early public measurements put the median near 404ms.

item.title: Ripple says OCC clears national trust bank after 10 months
item.description: Ripple says its trust bank has final OCC approval to manage RLUSD reserves and offer custody, while issuance stays with its New York regulated affiliate.
